tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on Reactions Of Acids

questions.question: Foundation Write the word equation for the reaction between hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide.
questions.correctAnswer: Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride + water
questions.explanation: Answer: Hydrochloric acid + sodium hydroxide → sodium chloride + water

questions.question: Foundation What ion do all acids produce in water? What ion do all alkalis produce in water?
questions.correctAnswer: Acids produce H⁺ ions. Alkalis produce OH⁻ ions.
questions.explanation: Answer: Acids produce H⁺ ions. Alkalis produce OH⁻ ions.
